high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "madovermarketing_mom." The post is titled "THE MOM QUIZ" and appears to be shared 10 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The content of the post discusses an innovative feature launched by TikTok in the United States. It mentions that TikTok has introduced a "Resume program," which is described as similar to LinkedIn but with a focus on showcasing dance moves. This suggests that users can use the platform to highlight their skills beyond just professional achievements.
